svg.aria-label: Original statement of Exercise 1.2.19. A filled square denotes a required nonzero leading entry; * is arbitrary (possibly zero). Suppose each matrix represents the augmented matrix for a system. Determine whether it is consistent, and if so, whether its solution is unique.
